landing.about_sub: Connecting, supporting, and empowering Tamils living across the globe.
landing.about_mission_text: TamilConnect was born from a simple truth — Tamils abroad often feel alone. We built this platform so that wherever you go in the world, your Tamil community is already there waiting for you. Whether you are a student, a worker, a professional, or a business owner, you never have to face a new country alone. TamilConnect exists to connect, support, and empower Tamils living across the globe. Tamils from both Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka are equally welcome here — TamilConnect belongs to all of us.
landing.about_mission_closing: For every Tamil living abroad — TamilConnect is your digital family.
landing.trust_sub: TamilConnect is built to help members connect, communicate, and support each other in a secure and trusted environment.
landing.trust_tagline: Connect with confidence. Your safety and privacy are always protected on TamilConnect.
landing.emergency_text: Facing a legal problem, medical emergency, or been cheated in a foreign country? Connect instantly with verified Tamil community members who can guide and support you — in any country, at any time.

features.title: Country Communities
features.desc: From the very first day in any new country — find housing, work, and community support through Tamils who have already been through the same journey.

features.title: Jobs & Career
features.desc: Share and find job opportunities, sponsored jobs, part-time roles, and internships — directly through fellow Tamils around the world.

features.title: Students Section
features.desc: Wherever you study abroad — find part-time jobs, scholarships, room share help, and project support. Everything a student needs, from day one.

features.title: Help & Support
features.desc: Facing a legal issue, emergency, or been cheated abroad? Trusted Tamil community members are always here to guide and support you — in any country.

features.title: Room & Accommodation Help
features.desc: Find rooms, share flats, and connect with Tamils for accommodation support.

features.title: Mental Wellbeing & Friendship Support
features.desc: Feeling lonely or stressed abroad? Find friends, emotional support, and a caring Tamil community.

features.title: Events & Festivals
features.desc: Discover and join Diwali, Pongal, and Tamil New Year celebrations happening in the country where you live, and connect with your local Tamil community.

features.title: Share Items
features.desc: Furniture, Electronics, Books, Kitchen items — Give away or receive unused items from fellow community members, helping others while reducing waste.

features.title: Direct Chat
features.desc: Private chats, country group chats, and topic-based groups — such, Students, and Business — allow you to connect and communicate directly with the community.

features.title: Tamil Business
features.desc: Tamils running businesses abroad can register and showcase their businesses, enabling direct trade and easier product shipping within the global Tamil community.

features.title: Member Profiles
features.desc: Create a profile with your country, city, profession, and education, then search for and connect with fellow Tamils. Find the right people easily, wherever you are.

features.title: Mentor Connect
features.desc: Experienced Tamils abroad will guide newcomers directly. Whether it is studies, career, or settling in — your mentor is always there for you.

steps.title: Sign Up
steps.desc: Create your profile easily by adding your name, country, city, and profession or field of study. It's completely free.

steps.title: Choose Your Country
steps.desc: Join the Tamil community in the country where you live and connect with local members.

steps.title: Get Help or Offer Support
steps.desc: Find jobs, get legal help, share items, or support others — everything your community needs, all in one place.

steps.title: Grow Your Network
steps.desc: Make new friends, join events, and build meaningful connections with the Tamil community wherever you are.

testimonials.name: Murugan Selvam
testimonials.quote: When I first moved to the UK, I didn't know anyone and felt completely alone. Through TamilConnect, I connected with other Tamils living in Manchester. They helped me find accommodation, guided me through local procedures, and even shared job opportunities. What could have taken months became much easier because of the community.

testimonials.name: Kavitha Rajan
testimonials.quote: While studying in Germany, I struggled to find a part-time job and didn't know where to start. Through the Students Section, I connected with a Tamil senior who guided me through the local job market and university resources. Today, I work part-time at a café and have a strong support network around me.

testimonials.name: Arjun Kumar
testimonials.quote: Moving to Canada was exciting but overwhelming. I didn't know where to start. Through TamilConnect, I connected with Tamils in Toronto, attended community events, and built real friendships within weeks. Settling into a new country became so much easier.

testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
testimonials.quote: When I needed advice about visa procedures and local services, members of the Australia Tamil community were incredibly helpful. The guidance I received saved me time, reduced stress, and gave me confidence.

trustCards.title: Verified Profiles
trustCards.desc: Members can verify their profiles to build trust within the community. Verified users receive a badge, helping others connect with genuine and reliable people.

trustCards.title: Block & Report
trustCards.desc: Instantly block unwanted users and report inappropriate behavior, harassment, spam, or suspicious activity. Reported accounts are reviewed by administrators.

trustCards.title: Privacy First
trustCards.desc: Personal information is protected and only shared according to your privacy settings. You have full control over what others can see.

trustCards.title: Spam Detection
trustCards.desc: Suspicious activities, fake accounts, and spam messages are automatically detected and removed to keep the platform safe and trustworthy.
